title: Fix admin enquiry page access denied for Advnitin1404@gmail.com

requirements.text: Fix admin authorization so the enquiries dashboard is accessible to the user with email Advnitin1404@gmail.com by making the backend authorized-admin email comparison case-insensitive and whitespace-tolerant (trim + lowercase on both stored profile email and authorized email).

quotes: Why Advnitin1404@gmail.com this mail is not able to access the enquiry page

acceptanceCriteria: When the caller is an admin and their saved profile email is any case/whitespace variant of "Advnitin1404@gmail.com" (e.g., "advnitin1404@gmail.com", " Advnitin1404@gmail.com "), backend methods getAllEnquiriesWithIds and markAnswered do not trap with Unauthorized.
The backend continues to deny access to non-admin callers and to admin callers whose saved profile email does not match the authorized email after normalization.

requirements.text: Update the enquiries dashboard UI to handle missing/incorrect user profile email: if the caller is authenticated but their user profile is missing or has an empty email, show a "Complete Profile" form (name + email) that saves via saveCallerUserProfile, then re-check authorization and load enquiries when authorized.
acceptanceCriteria: If the user is logged in and getCallerUserProfile returns null or an email that is empty/whitespace, the page shows a profile form instead of the generic "Access Denied" message.
Submitting the profile form persists the profile via the backend and triggers a refresh of admin/profile/enquiries queries.
After saving a profile email matching Advnitin1404@gmail.com (case-insensitive), the enquiries list loads without requiring a hard refresh.

requirements.text: Improve the "Access Denied" state on the enquiries dashboard to clearly indicate why access was denied by showing (a) whether isCallerAdmin is true/false and (b) the current saved profile email value (or "not set") so the admin can self-diagnose setup issues.
acceptanceCriteria: When access is denied, the UI displays the admin-check result (admin vs not admin) and the currently loaded profile email value (or 'not set').
All user-facing text is in English and does not expose sensitive implementation details beyond the above status.

requirements.text: Add a React Query mutation hook to save the caller user profile (calling saveCallerUserProfile) and use it from the enquiries dashboard profile form.
acceptanceCriteria: A new mutation exists for saveCallerUserProfile and is used by the enquiries dashboard to persist name/email.
On success, relevant cached queries (currentUserProfile, isCallerAdmin, enquiries) are invalidated/refetched so the UI updates immediately.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only components must be composed, not modified).
Do not edit frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts(x), frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, or frontend/src/main.tsx (immutable paths).
Keep all Motoko logic in the single backend actor (backend/main.mo).
nonGoals: Adding any third-party authentication provider (only Internet Identity is used).
Changing the public website content/sections unrelated to the enquiries/admin access flow.
